verdict.rationale: Community comments confirm Airweave publishes plan-based pricing, but describe it as complex to reason about and built on plan limits with no pay-as-you-go option. That cuts against the per-unit rates the story needs for projecting costs. The only free path in evidence is self-hosting the open-source repo; no hosted free tier or rate card is documented. Missing for 10: first-party pricing documentation, an evidenced hosted free tier, per-unit or usage-based rates, and any memory or storage cost metrics for projection.
